description: Unreleased Google Cloud resources dropped under drop_reason 'blocked-on-brownfield' because implementation or E2E testing requires new fields or features in an existing KCC brownfield/parent resource (#16072).

exclusions.reason: Blocked on brownfield ComputeInstanceGroupManager (v1beta1) lacking instanceLifecyclePolicy.defaultActionOnFailure=DO_NOTHING to disable auto-repair (#16072, #15990).
Blocked on FirestoreDatabase (v1beta1) lacking databaseEdition=ENTERPRISE required for UserCreds creation (#16072, #15331).
Blocked on brownfield NetworkConnectivitySpoke (v1beta1 DCL) lacking NCC Gateway spoke fields such as linkedGateway (#16072, #15326).
